page.layout: Two parallel columns of German words, each word with its gloss, set in black letter. The left column holds the headwords and the right column the glosses. The running head is centred above both columns. The catchword "Galle" stands alone at the lower right, below the last line.
page.notes: The page is set entirely in black letter, so no black letter tags are used. The right edge of the scan cuts the end of "Landsknecht Bettlin" and the reading "Bettlin" is doubtful. "Glathart" is read from a worn letter and is doubtful. The "¶" before "Glentz" is copied as printed. The gloss "Galle" at the lower right is the catchword. No page number is printed.
